data.name: Error.8800.Message
data.value: 1. ASIC communication error 2. ASIC CRC error 3. ASIC short frame error 4. ASIC overrunning error 5. ASIC connector connection error 6. ASIC 0byte transmission

data.name: Error.8800.Cause
data.value: 1. ASIC communication error: A failure was detected in the communication within the controller. The internal temperature of the controller may be high. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, the following conditions may also be the cause. The power on timing may be incorrect. The cable between the controller and the robot CPU may have a fault. 2. ASIC CRC error: A failure was detected in the communication within the controller. The internal temperature of the controller may be high. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, the following conditions may also be the cause. The power on timing may be incorrect. The cable between the controller and the robot CPU may have a fault. 3. ASIC short frame error: A failure was detected in the communication within the controller. The internal temperature of the controller may be high. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, the following conditions may also be the cause. The power on timing may be incorrect. The cable between the controller and the robot CPU may have a fault. 4. ASIC overrunning error: A failure was detected in the communication within the controller. The internal temperature of the controller may be high. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, the following conditions may also be the cause. The power on timing may be incorrect. The cable between the controller and the robot CPU may have a fault. 5. ASIC connector connection error: A failure was detected in the communication within the controller. The internal temperature of the controller may be high. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, the following conditions may also be the cause. The power on timing may be incorrect. The cable between the controller and the robot CPU may have a fault. 6. ASIC 0byte transmission: A failure was detected in the communication within the controller. The internal temperature of the controller may be high. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, the following conditions may also be the cause. The power on timing may be incorrect. The cable between the controller and the robot CPU may have a fault.

data.name: Error.8800.Measures
data.value: 1. ASIC communication error: Confirm that the controller filter has no clogging and the ambient temperature is 40 or less. If the error persists after taking above measures, contact the manufacturer. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, turn on the switch of the controller, then of the robot CPU. Check the cable connection between the robot CPU and the controller. Power off and on, unless otherwise noted. 2. ASIC CRC error: Confirm that the controller filter has no clogging and the ambient temperature is 40 or less. If the error persists after taking above measures, contact the manufacturer. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, turn on the switch of the controller, then of the robot CPU. Check the cable connection between the robot CPU and the controller. Power off and on, unless otherwise noted. 3. ASIC short frame error: Confirm that the controller filter has no clogging and the ambient temperature is 40 or less. If the error persists after taking above measures, contact the manufacturer. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, turn on the switch of the controller, then of the robot CPU. Check the cable connection between the robot CPU and the controller. Power off and on, unless otherwise noted. 4. ASIC overrunning error: Confirm that the controller filter has no clogging and the ambient temperature is 40 or less. If the error persists after taking above measures, contact the manufacturer. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, turn on the switch of the controller, then of the robot CPU. Check the cable connection between the robot CPU and the controller. Power off and on, unless otherwise noted. 5. ASIC connector connection error: Confirm that the controller filter has no clogging and the ambient temperature is 40 or less. If the error persists after taking above measures, contact the manufacturer. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, turn on the switch of the controller, then of the robot CPU. Check the cable connection between the robot CPU and the controller. Power off and on, unless otherwise noted. 6. ASIC 0byte transmission: Confirm that the controller filter has no clogging and the ambient temperature is 40 or less. If the error persists after taking above measures, contact the manufacturer. For the CR800-R/CR800-Q controller, turn on the switch of the controller, then of the robot CPU. Check the cable connection between the robot CPU and the controller. Power off and on, unless otherwise noted.

data.name: Error.8830.Message
data.value: 1. Amplifier unconnection 2. Servo axis setting error 3. Uncorrespondence amplifier 4. Uncorrespondence protocol 5. Illegal motor ID 6. Parameter setting failure 7. Illegal amp. number

data.name: Error.8830.Cause
data.value: 1. Amplifier unconnection: The servo amplifier cannot be detected 2. Servo axis setting error: The axis setting is not correct 3. Uncorrespondence amplifier: Uncorrespondence amplifier is connected 4. Uncorrespondence protocol: The communication protocol which does not correspond 5. Illegal motor ID: Uncorrespondence motor is connected 6. Parameter setting failure: A set value of the servo parameter is illegal 7. Illegal amp. number: The number of connected amplifiers is not suitable

data.name: Error.8830.Measures
data.value: 1. Amplifier unconnection: Check the cable connection and the power supply of amp. 2. Servo axis setting error: Check the servo axis settings (parameters, rotary switches) 3. Uncorrespondence amplifier: Remove the uncorrespondence amplifier 4. Uncorrespondence protocol: Remove the uncorrespondence amplifier 5. Illegal motor ID: Remove the uncorrespondence motor 6. Parameter setting failure: Change to a correct value 7. Illegal amp. number: Check the number of connected amplifiers
